webhooks.intro: New feedback is posted to these destinations. Delivery runs in the background with retries, so a webhook that is down never blocks or fails a user's message.

kindHint.json: POSTs a JSON payload signed with HMAC-SHA256. See docs/feedback.md.

webhooks.urlHint: https only, public addresses only. The URL is stored encrypted and never shown again.

webhooks.envPending: {env} is set and will be imported as a webhook when the API restarts.
